# Shivas' Snowball (LV-343)
[italic]Date 2177 - Shivas' Snowball. A United Americas mining and research colony.[/italic]
[bold]Shivas' Snowball[/bold] is a small [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"] research colony on the frozen world LV-343, drilling into its ice sheets in search of ancient microbial life.
## History - In 2082 an Argentinian deep space probe found chemical signs that life had once existed on LV-343. Scientists believe the planet was once temperate before falling into an ice age around 98,000 years ago. An expedition was planned but never funded. - In 2116, with the newly formed UA turning its attention to projects closer to the Core Systems, the Argentinian expedition was finally approved, with [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] as its main backer. - After four years of surveys, a safe landing site was confirmed in 2120 and the first colonists arrived. The colony was built from cheap prefabricated materials and was fully operational by 2122.
## The Colony - The colony's researchers extract ice cores and analyze them in their labs for signs of microbial life. - It is plagued by [bold]giant spiders[/bold], descendants of an invasive species that stowed away on the first ship. LV-343's low air pressure and high oxygen have let them grow far larger than their Earth ancestors. - The colony contracted Weyland-Yutani to protect its staff from the spiders, and a Company liaison was sent to coordinate between the security forces and the researchers.
## LV-343 An ice world with a single cratered moon, LV-343 orbits a Sun-like star alongside a gas giant and a small, barren rocky planet.
